brief: A storage box whose lid is held shut with magnets.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.evidence: Box formed by 4 cells at level 0 (piece:-1,0,0;full, piece:0,0,0;full, piece:0,1,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full) and 4 walls at level 1 (piece:-1,0,1;full, piece:0,0,1;full, piece:0,1,1;full, piece:1,0,1;full) with side caps closing open faces and top covers forming lid.

Four top covers at level 1 (cover:-1,0,1;full;top, cover:0,0,1;full;top, cover:0,1,1;full;top, cover:1,0,1;full;top) cover the box opening. Covers include magnets by default (setCoverMagnets on:true is pre-fitted; verified by refusal ALREADY_FITTED), providing magnetic retention of lid to base.

finish.summary: Built a 4-cell storage box with two storeys (base + walls), side faces capped, and four top covers forming the lid. Covers are magnet-fitted by default, satisfying the magnetic closure.

lines.label: Edge cap · male, two stories tall
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
